<span style="font-size: 0.85em;">
**Disclaimer:** This is research in progress. Estimates are based on data from 2024 adjusted to reflect house price changes up to June 2026. The estimates give a guideline but they cannot provide precise predictions because they are based on only few observable variables. Only houses below $3,000,000 were considered because higher priced houses crucially depend on individual properties Therefore, predictions for high priced houses are less relaible. 
</span>
:::

## Detailed Report

The detailed report features will be fianlized soon and they are currently in the stae of *work in progress*.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### House Scale and Layout

Since Sqft and the number of Bedrooms are closly related only their joint impact can be quantified.
 A so called Principal Component Analysis was used the quantify their joined **total impact** on the house price.

In many (but not all) cases one of the principa components represesets the **Scale:**, the "bigness" of the house while the other principal componente represents the **Layout (ratio between sqft and bedrooms)**. 




You have chosen a house with the following properties:

**Sqft:** {{ Sqft | digit0_format }}\
**Avg. in LA County:**  {{ AvgSqft  | digit0_format }}

**Number of Bedrooms:** {{ Bedrooms }}\
**Avg. in LA County:** {{ AvgBedrooms  | digit0_format }}

#### Premium (+)/Discount (-)

The **total Premium (+)/Discount (-)** is: {{ SHAPPCA1PCA2 | currency_format }}

The first principal component (**Scale**) contributes {{ SHAPPCA1 | currency_format }} while the second principal component  (**Layout**) contributes {{ SHAPPCA2 | currency_format }}.
:::
